calendars.containment: half-open; both entry and exit contained; exit may equal end

definitions.base_fee_no_tail: all nonzero primary signs, same scheduler and hold
definitions.base_fee_one_epoch_stale: median2[e-1] versus median2[e-3], no earlier than e availability
definitions.deterministic_random_side: SHA256(UTF-8(ESDI-288|primary|epoch_id=<canonical decimal integer>|RANDOM_SIDE)); first byte <128 LONG else SHORT
definitions.exact_direction_flip: accepted primary entries with side flipped
definitions.gas_utilization_only: same lag, exact prior-180 midrank, threshold, side, scheduler and hold on exact mean gas-used ratio
definitions.one_bar_delayed_entry: accepted primary parent set shifted 300s without rerunning non-overlap

economic_contract.strict_mdd: global/pre-entry HWM; favorable OHLC and funding credits before adverse OHLC, funding debits, liquidation envelope and exit cost

execution.exit_price: BTCUSDT perpetual 5m open at exact scheduled exit

feature_and_signal.rank_history: exactly previous 180 finite feature rows; current excluded

serialization.manifest_hash: SHA256 compact sorted-key JSON excluding manifest_hash

clock_reconstruction.stage: after ESDI source-support pass and before ESDI economics

fresh_kimchi_fx.side: AUTO from exact exclusive long/short gates

gross9.comparison: unscaled authoritative Gross9 baseline at gross 9.0
gross9.ranking: maximum minimum base/stress 2023H2/2024 improvement; tie lower weight
gross9.treatment: scale every sleeve by (9-w)/9 and add ESDI at w

clock_identity.comparison_domain: registry half-open domain; filter both ESDI and comparator entries to the identical domain
clock_identity.timestamp: integer UTC Unix seconds; no rounding

metric_applicability.directional_interval: all three prior-source metrics are mandatory
metric_applicability.timestamp_only: exact-entry Jaccard and candidate +/-24h containment are mandatory; signed-exposure Pearson is inapplicable and must be reported as such, never zero-filled

metric_definitions.absolute_signed_exposure_pearson_gate: exact squared Pearson; compare prior-source <=4/25 and Gross9 <=49/400; report nonnegative square root only
metric_definitions.candidate_containment: max(fraction of A within +/-window of any B, fraction of B within +/-window of any A)
metric_definitions.occupied_bar_jaccard: Jaccard of bar indexes with nonzero signed exposure
metric_definitions.signed_exposure: {-1,0,1} on every 5m bar open in the common domain

source.base_fee_vector_sha256_serialization: exactly 3600 positive uint256 integers, each as 32-byte unsigned big-endian, concatenated in ascending block order
source.median2: sort 3600 positive integer base fees; values[1799]+values[1800]
